parsed.rationale: Three sibling types in the same `PlayerHeaderView` package — `RMSProcessor.reset` (line 55), `FFTProcessor.reset` (line 183), and `AverageProcessor.reset` (line 54) — are flagged as exact function duplicates, meaning their `reset()` bodies are identical. Because all three live in the same package and none carry any restraint markers (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen` are all false), the idiomatic Swift resolution is to introduce a shared protocol (e.g., `AudioProcessor`) that these types already conform to or can be made to conform to, and provide a single default implementation of `reset()` in a protocol extension. This eliminates the three redundant bodies while preserving each type's distinct processing logic.
